findings.failure_scenario: provides.doctor declares aa.cfg as category config with probe [bin/aa, doctor]. The probe prints one valid check-result for aa.cfg with status ok, category state, observed 'actually fine'. swissknifeman doctor --unit aa --category config --json returns exit 1 and a single result aa.cfg status fail observed 'probe printed no result for this check'. The ok document was parsed and then discarded.
findings.reproduction: Temp unit aa with that manifest and probe; umbrella.collect_doctor(units, ['aa'], ['config'], 5) returned the synthetic fail and no ok row.

triage_reproduction.cmd: временные модули aa/bb/cc с unit.json; PYTHONPATH=packages/aicore/lib SKM_UNITS_PATH=<tmp> python3: umbrella.collect_doctor(load_units(), ['aa'], ['config'], 5)
triage_reproduction.observed: aa [('aa.cfg','fail','config','probe printed no result for this check')] — валидный ok-документ aa.cfg с категорией state был отброшен фильтром категории по документу (umbrella.py:386), потом добавлен синтетический fail

findings.failure_scenario: A declared check has category integration and its probe prints non-JSON. swissknifeman doctor --category integration --json includes check_id <unit>.doctor with category environment. The row is outside the requested category. packages/aicore/unit.json puts aicore.ext in integration and points the probe at bin/aicore ext status with output text, which is this path.
findings.reproduction: Temp unit cc, doctor id cc.ext category integration, probe prints 'not json'; umbrella.collect_doctor(units, ['cc'], ['integration'], 5) returned cc.doctor category environment. aicore unit.json and aicore.ext.cli._run_status confirm the live probe is text unless --json is passed, and the manifest does not pass --json.
